main:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads N and N integers, sorts them, computes two alternative two-pointer difference scores using a shared used-marker array, and prints the maximum of the two scores." main]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Read integer N via Z(). RESULT N]
            [COMMAND Set A to an empty list. For each of N iterations, read an integer via Z() and append it to A. RESULT A]
            [COMMAND Sort A in ascending order and assign the sorted list back to A. RESULT A]
            [COMMAND Initialize phase 1 state: used = [0] * N; output1 = 0; output2 = 0; i1 = 0; i2 = 0; j1 = N-1; j2 = N-2; f1 = True; f2 = True. RESULT phase1_state]
            [COMMAND Mark the initial phase 1 used positions: set used[i1], used[i2], used[j1], and used[j2] to 1, meaning used[0] is set twice, used[N-1] is set once, and the index N-2 is set once. RESULT used]
            [COMMAND While f1 or f2 is true, perform the first pair of accumulation operations: if f1 is true, add A[j1] - A[i1] to output1; if f2 is true, add A[j2] - A[i2] to output1. RESULT output1]
            [COMMAND Within the same while loop, advance i1 forward past already used positions: while used[i1] is true, if i1 == N-1 then set f1 to False and break, otherwise increment i1; after the while loop, set used[i1] to 1. This step executes regardless of whether f1 is still true. RESULT i1]
            [COMMAND Within the same while loop, advance i2 forward past already used positions: while used[i2] is true, if i2 == N-1 then set f2 to False and break, otherwise increment i2; after the while loop, set used[i2] to 1. This step executes regardless of whether f2 is still true. RESULT i2]
            [COMMAND After the i pointers have advanced in the same loop iteration, perform the second pair of phase 1 accumulations using the updated i1 and i2: if f1 is true, add A[j1] - A[i1] to output1; if f2 is true, add A[j2] - A[i2] to output1. RESULT output1]
            [COMMAND Within the same while loop, advance j1 backward past already used positions: while used[j1] is true, if j1 == 0 then set f1 to False and break, otherwise decrement j1; after the while loop, set used[j1] to 1. This step executes regardless of whether f1 is still true. RESULT j1]
            [COMMAND Within the same while loop, advance j2 backward past already used positions: while used[j2] is true, if j2 == 0 then set f2 to False and break, otherwise decrement j2; after the while loop, set used[j2] to 1. This step executes regardless of whether f2 is still true. RESULT j2]
            [COMMAND Repeat the phase 1 while loop until both f1 and f2 are false, completing output1. RESULT output1]
            [COMMAND Initialize phase 2 state: i1 = 0; i2 = 1; j1 = N-1; j2 = N-1; f1 = True; f2 = True; used = [0] * N. RESULT phase2_state]
            [COMMAND Mark the initial phase 2 used positions: set used[i1], used[i2], used[j1], and used[j2] to 1, meaning used[0], used[1], and used[N-1] are set to 1, with used[N-1] set twice because j1 equals j2. RESULT used]
            [COMMAND While f1 or f2 is true, perform the first pair of phase 2 accumulation operations: if f1 is true, add A[j1] - A[i1] to output2; if f2 is true, add A[j2] - A[i2] to output2. RESULT output2]
            [COMMAND Within the same while loop, advance j1 backward past already used positions: while used[j1] is true, if j1 == 0 then set f1 to False and break, otherwise decrement j1; after the while loop, set used[j1] to 1. This step executes regardless of whether f1 is still true. RESULT j1]
            [COMMAND Within the same while loop, advance j2 backward past already used positions: while used[j2] is true, if j2 == 0 then set f2 to False and break, otherwise decrement j2; after the while loop, set used[j2] to 1. This step executes regardless of whether f2 is still true. RESULT j2]
            [COMMAND After the j pointers have advanced in the same loop iteration, perform the second pair of phase 2 accumulations using the updated j1 and j2: if f1 is true, add A[j1] - A[i1] to output2; if f2 is true, add A[j2] - A[i2] to output2. RESULT output2]
            [COMMAND Within the same while loop, advance i1 forward past already used positions: while used[i1] is true, if i1 == N-1 then set f1 to False and break, otherwise increment i1; after the while loop, set used[i1] to 1. This step executes regardless of whether f1 is still true. RESULT i1]
            [COMMAND Within the same while loop, advance i2 forward past already used positions: while used[i2] is true, if i2 == N-1 then set f2 to False and break, otherwise increment i2; after the while loop, set used[i2] to 1. This step executes regardless of whether f2 is still true. RESULT i2]
            [COMMAND Repeat the phase 2 while loop until both f1 and f2 are false, completing output2. RESULT output2]
            [COMMAND Compute max(output1, output2) and print the resulting integer. RESULT printed_max]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
